newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Bosnian Serb Republic founds own airline - agency.
newsitem.headline: Bosnian Serb Republic founds own airline - agency.

text.p: The Serb entity in Bosnia-Herzegovina has formed its own air company called RS Airlines, the Bosnian Serb news agency SRNA reported Tuesday.

The first airline in the Bosnian Serb Republic (RS) has been formed in accordance with a decision by the ministry for traffic and communications, SRNA quoted sources in the newly formed company as saying.
The home airport of RS Airlines will be in Banja Luka in northern Bosnia and the first flights will be to Belgrade, Podgorica, Tivat and Nis.
In the near future, the air carrier plans to open flights to Salonika, Moscow, Bari, Timisoara and Budapest, director of the RS national air company Jovan Tintor said.
"Two Russian 32-seater JAK-40 jets have been purchased for the company needs and a M-8 helicopter which can carry 25 passangers on domestic flights," RS Airlines commercial director Simo Simic said.
The company has been registered for domestic and international regular and charter traffic, SRNA said. -- Zorana Vucicevic, Belgrade newsroom +381 11 222 4305
